scope: Synthetic algebra, integration, numerical feasibility only; no campaign observations fitted or target configurations selected
checks: k0 analytic independent Gaussian convolutions of life error and logGamma uncertainty
literal infinity atom and positive-infinity CDF endpoint
v=0 exact reduction to frozen scalar adapter
u/v posterior, predictive CDF and score against independent product-prior Hermite quadrature
failure versus right-censor likelihood and runout-only update
u=0 still updates v using genuine marginal likelihood
query endpoint perturbation ignored by predictions; no population mutation
positive global u interval pruning agrees with full frozen conditional-u integral
per-row event-specific likelihood equals frozen both-branch evaluation
fast score and far-tail evidence-ratio fallback match same predictive model

integration_statement.latent_Gamma_rule: Fixed positive96-node population quadrature reused; no continuous-Gamma quadrature-error theorem
integration_statement.u_and_v_mass_bounds: Mathematical truncation/pruning bounds conditional on that rule; all potentially important modes retained
integration_statement.rule_order_differences: Numerical resolution estimates, not formal analytic discretization bounds
integration_statement.fast_score: Positive posterior mixture; independent u/v rule checks include conditional-u evidence effect on v weights; relative tail bound transformed by -log1p(-r)
integration_statement.far_tail_fallback: Per-query separately checked marginal-evidence ratio; no query-containing object enters selected-support/model cache
integration_statement.k0: Exact Gaussian convolutions at model-distribution level; Gamma expectation remains same numerical rule

limitations: Population parameters and prior-hyperparameter selection are plug-in
No physical-build covariance or R90C90 guarantee
One synthetic limiting case or runtime fixture is not physical validation
